mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_message (session_id, sender, message_type, content) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{sender}, #{messageType}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, sender, message_type, content, created_at FROM interview_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interview_message m JOIN interview_session s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.sender = 'USER' AND m.message_type = 'ANSWER'
